ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values; the visible ventral surface is approximately 95-98% black/dark grey with isolated high-intensity white pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant continuous dark-pigment field across both lobes. Sparse, high-contrast white punctate clusters are distributed non-uniformly, with a notable concentration on the distal third of the right lobe (image right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 50 degrees, extending deeply toward the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serration along the entire visible trailing edge boundary. Right lobe distal tip exhibits irregular, high-amplitude jaggedness compared to the more uniform left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; proximal regions adjacent to the notch exhibit moderate convexity, transitioning to slight concavity as the lobes taper toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (<10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark field, resembling barnacle attachment scars, primarily on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion or trauma-induced notches located on the far distal trailing edge of the right lobe, departing from the standard serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of dark pigmentation (Type 1 fluke classification) with minimal white patterning except for small punctate scarring.
